summary.plain: The team of physicists who ran the DAMIC silicon-CCD dark matter search, first at Fermilab and then at SNOLAB in Canada.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the DAMIC CCD-based direct-detection programme at SNOLAB, continuous with an earlier Fermilab prototype phase and related to the DAMIC-M programme at Modane.
